play_guide.label: Boss moving: Pinnacle (worst case)'s dashes, leaps and charges
play_guide.play: at most 55% of the fight moving in its own dashes / leaps / charges against Pinnacle (worst case) (an upper bound: each used off cooldown, 0.5 s of travel each, UNVERIFIED; walking is the player's choice and teleports don't count; MECHD3, RESEARCH22 #122); a melee skill can't reach it while it travels: 11,497 DPS at that ceiling, 25,548 with the boss in reach (the headline). Close the gap at once after each dash
play_guide.confidence: theory (an upper bound on the loss; the travel time UNVERIFIED, MECH-D's LOW)

play_guide.label: Armour Broken (up 73% of the fight)
play_guide.play: kept up by the build's own rates 73% of the fight, counted at that share (28,830 DPS were it always up)

play_guide.label: Heavily Stunned 45% of the fight while channelling with your shield raised*
play_guide.play: channelling holds the shield raised and the bar never decays: 0.81 blocked boss hits a second (the 41% that are Blockable, one every 0.51 s; no Evasion while raised, so each builds stun: the manager's ruling), 45% of the bar each on average (Physical 40% of hits, 57% of the bar (75% if Melee); Fire 21% of hits, 48% of the bar (64% if Melee); Cold 15% of hits, 21% of the bar (28% if Melee); Lightning 21% of hits, 19% of the bar (25% if Melee): 0.65 (the game's HeavyStunDamageScalePlayer) x the hit after mitigation / Stun Threshold 2,776, a monster's Physical x2, its Melee x1.33 on 38% of hits), so a Heavy Stun every 3 blocked hits (3.7 s), 3 s each with no attacking, Block or Evasion: 45% of the fight. Releasing early to let it decay costs more time (2 s delay + up to 2 s of decay per bar), so not chosen (MEDIUM); every hit at its type's biggest ordinary hit (a harsh bound; the headline uses the average hit): 55% of the fight. 25,548 DPS with the Heavy Stuns (the headline), 46,294 if none landed. A higher Stun Threshold (Life; Unbreakable, Steadfast; Dionadair's double while raised) or more Evasion (an equal chance to avoid the buildup) cuts them
play_guide.confidence: MEDIUM (the buildup factor is the game's constant; its formula PoB's for monsters)

play_guide.label: Seething Body: pause near the top of Infernal Flame
play_guide.play: cast until Infernal Flame is nearly full, then stop for about 3.4s (2 s before it decays, then 25% of its maximum per second back to High): Elemental Archon stays up (it doesn't expire on High Flame) and the bar doesn't reset (no Fire hit of your maximum Life and Energy Shield), but you cast 59% of the time: 15,845 DPS with pausing, 25,548 without (the headline: fill and reset); not worth it for this build
play_guide.confidence: theory (decay rate and its basis MEDIUM; the player's timing LOW)
